question:
Select the correct homonym to fill in the blank in the given sentence.

I will just _______ some figures for comparison.
solution:
The correct answer is Option no. (2)** 'cite'**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **'Cite' **means to quote or refer to (a passage, book, or author) as evidence or justification for an argument or statement.
 
• In the given sentence, the speaker is talking about mentioning some figures for comparison, which fits the meaning of** 'cite'.(उल्लेख करना)**

Therefore the correct answer is option no.**(2)** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The other options have different meanings**: -
 
• 'Cete' is not a commonly used word in English and does not fit the context.
 
• **'Site' **refers to a location or place.**(कार्य स्थल)**
 
• **'Sight'** refers to the ability to see or a view.**(दृष्टि)**
